dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: Hey there. If you're here to view the goods, I'm afraid I'm still waiting on the latest delivery...

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: But trust me, it'll be worth the wait. Everything I sell is freshly acquired, straight off the boat!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you a fishmonger?

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: Fishmonger? Are you trying to suss me out or something? No need, let me tell you how it is, plain and simple.

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: Let's put it like this: I can get you whatever you need, from wherever it is — as long as the price is right.

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: Even if it's from Inazuma, if you catch my drift.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: Before, it would have been a monumental task to get to Inazuma. If you were lucky enough to make it across the ocean alive, that border would be impenetrable.

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: But that's all in the past now. The trade routes have been opened, so I can get over there and get you anything you need, whenever you need it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: Alright, if you're not buying then don't stick around... We don't want to attract the Millelith's attention...

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: ...But I should tell you up front, I don't deal with any goods from Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: ...Except if it's from Inazuma. It's not about the money, I'm just not taking that kind of risk.

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: Tell me more about Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: For the average person, getting into Inazuma is nigh on impossible!

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: Even if you're lucky enough to make it across the ocean alive, that border is simply impenetrable.

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: I do not understand their national administration's mindset. Far too isolationist in my opinion...

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: Not long ago, I actually rescued a girl who escaped from Inazuma... She's the only person I've ever known to get out of there without official approval.

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: So, if you're one of these who is desperate for a new Inazuman toy to play with, I'm telling you — let it go!

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
